AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/SceneViewGestures.qml
IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0
    TRAVERSE TouchArea
        LOCATE BEFORE ALL
    INSERT {
        // WeRead hot-review popup — the ONLY QML this project injects
        // now. The fullscreen QML reader that used to live here is
        // deprecated (docs/design.md §"已废弃：全屏 QML 阅读器"):
        // reading happens in xochitl's own PDF reader on documents the
        // daemon generates, so this patch shrank from a fullscreen
        // surface back down to rm-agent's proven popup size.
        //
        // NOTE: every comment must live inside this INSERT block — the
        // .qmd grammar rejects top-level `//` lines (confirmed on
        // device; fails safe but silent).
        //
        // This QML runs INSIDE xochitl's process. Always validate with
        // `xovi/debug` in the foreground before making it persistent.
        //
        // Two interactions:
        //  1. Four-finger tap -> the shelf browser: pick any book and
        //     the daemon generates it, with progress from gen.txt.
        //  2. Touch the underlined words themselves -> hit-test against
        //     layout/<docUuid>.json's `taps` boxes, touch
        //     `ask_<bookId>_<chapterUid>_<range>_<nonce>`, poll reviews.txt,
        //     show the popup. Taps that miss every underline pass
        //     through untouched (mouse.accepted = false), so page turns
        //     behave exactly as before on the rest of the page.
        //     There is no marker glyph: the dashed underline is its own
        //     affordance, which is also what removed the old ①..⑳ cap
        //     that left most underlines untappable.
        //
        // ── How we get the current page (was this design's one open
        // question; answered on a real Paper Pro, 3.27.3.0) ──
        // `touchArea.view` is the SceneView. It hands us everything
        // hit-testing needs, so nothing has to be inferred:
        //   view.page            0-based index of the page on screen
        //   view.pageBorderRect  that page's on-screen rect, in
        //                        touchArea's own coordinate space
        //   view.document.id     xochitl uuid of the open document,
        //                        which is also the key layouts are
        //                        filed under (layout/<uuid>.json)
        // Using pageBorderRect instead of assuming "3:4 PDF fills the
        // 3:4 screen 1:1" means zoom and pan work for free — the rect
        // already accounts for both. Because a layout is looked up *by*
        // document.id, finding one is itself the proof that this PDF is
        // ours — tap boxes can never fire in somebody else's document.
        // These names were found by walking the parent chain from here
        // and logging property names under `xovi/debug`; there is no
        // QML on disk to read (it lives in xochitl's qrc), so runtime
        // introspection is the way to re-derive them after a firmware
        // bump.

        TouchAreaClickFilter {
            id: weReadGenerateFilter
            palmAreaThreshold: touchArea.tapPalmThreshold
            enabled: !touchArea.panAndZoomOnly
            fingers: 4
            onClick: weReadShelf.open()
        }

        CommandExecutor {
            id: weReadCmd
        }

        FontLoader {
            id: weReadFont
            source: "file:///home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/NotoSansSC.ttf"
        }

        Item {
            id: weReadIpc
            visible: false
            function beacon(name) {
                weReadCmd.executeCommand("/bin/touch", ["/home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/beacon_" + name]);
            }

            // console.log is invisible here — xochitl installs its own
            // Qt message handler and QT_LOGGING_RULES does not get past
            // it, so every "no output" reading during this experiment
            // was uninformative rather than negative. Beacons are files.
            Component.onCompleted: beacon("ipc")
            // Layouts are stored per *document* uuid, so several books
            // can be on the device at once. Each is a few hundred KB and
            // JSON.parse blocks the UI thread, so parse at most once per
            // document and remember which one is loaded — including the
            // misses, so a tap in an unrelated PDF costs one file probe
            // and never re-parses.
            property var layoutData: null
            property string layoutDocId: ""

            function readFile(name) {
                var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                try {
                    xhr.open("GET", "file:///home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/" + name, false);
                    xhr.send();
                    return xhr.responseText || "";
                } catch (e) {
                    return "";
                }
            }

            function readSeq(name) {
                var n = parseInt(readFile(name).split("\n")[0]);
                return isNaN(n) ? 0 : n;
            }

            // chapterUid -> tap boxes fetched while reading, and the
            // set already asked for so a page turn inside one chapter
            // doesn't re-trigger. Underlines are no longer baked into
            // layout.json for newly generated books: they are fetched
            // one chapter at a time, when you actually reach it.
            property var hotByChapter: ({})
            property var hotAsked: ({})
            property int hotSeq: 0

            // Chapter covering an absolute page, or null.
            function chapterAt(page) {
                var l = layoutData;
                if (!l || !l.chapters) return null;
                for (var i = 0; i < l.chapters.length; i++) {
                    var c = l.chapters[i];
                    if (page >= c.page_start && page < c.page_start + c.page_count) return c;
                }
                return null;
            }

            // Every tap box known for `page`: whatever the frozen layout
            // carries (older books, where they were baked in) plus
            // anything fetched at reading time.
            function tapsForPage(page) {
                var out = [];
                var l = layoutData;
                if (l && l.taps) {
                    for (var i = 0; i < l.taps.length; i++) {
                        if (l.taps[i].page === page) out.push(l.taps[i]);
                    }
                }
                for (var uid in hotByChapter) {
                    var set = hotByChapter[uid];
                    for (var j = 0; j < set.length; j++) {
                        if (set[j].page === page) out.push(set[j]);
                    }
                }
                return out;
            }

            // Ask the daemon for this page's chapter, once.
            function requestHot(page) {
                var l = layoutData;
                if (!l || !l.book_id) return;
                var c = chapterAt(page);
                if (!c) return;
                var key = "" + c.chapter_uid;
                if (hotAsked[key] || hotByChapter[key]) return;
                hotAsked[key] = true;
                weReadCmd.executeCommand("/bin/touch", [
                    "/home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/hot_" + l.book_id + "_" + c.chapter_uid
                        + "_" + Date.now()
                ]);
                weReadHotPoller.restart();
            }

            function loadHot(bookId, chapterUid) {
                var raw = readFile("hot/" + bookId + "_" + chapterUid + ".json");
                if (!raw) return false;
                try {
                    var arr = JSON.parse(raw);
                    var m = hotByChapter;
                    m["" + chapterUid] = arr;
                    hotByChapter = m;
                    return true;
                } catch (e) {
                    return false;
                }
            }

            // Layout for whatever document is open, or null. Because
            // the file is keyed by document uuid, finding one *is* the
            // proof that this PDF is ours — no separate doc_uuid check.
            function currentLayout() {
                var id = openDocId();
                if (!id) return null;
                if (layoutDocId === id) return layoutData;
                layoutDocId = id;
                layoutData = null;
                hotByChapter = ({});
                hotAsked = ({});
                var raw = readFile("layout/" + id + ".json");
                if (raw) {
                    try { layoutData = JSON.parse(raw); } catch (e) { layoutData = null; }
                }
                return layoutData;
            }

            // Opening the "＋ 书架" card is the library-side entry
            // point: the shelf browser lives in this patch, and this
            // documentview file is the only injection point whose root
            // type (TouchArea) is known — the library's own QML files
            // have custom root types that qmldiff's TRAVERSE cannot be
            // aimed at, and xochitl's QML is compiled, so they cannot be
            // read off the device. A document is the one thing that is
            // both visible in the folder and able to reach this code.
            property string docId: {
                try {
                    var d = touchArea.view.document;
                    return d ? ("" + d.id) : "";
                } catch (e) {
                    return "";
                }
            }

            onDocIdChanged: {
                if (!docId) return;
                if (docId === readFile("shelf_doc.txt").trim()) weReadShelf.open();
            }

            // xochitl uuid of the document currently open, "" if none.
            function openDocId() {
                try {
                    var d = touchArea.view.document;
                    return d ? ("" + d.id) : "";
                } catch (e) {
                    return "";
                }
            }

            // 0-based page of the PDF currently on screen, or -1 when
            // the open document is not one we generated (so taps in
            // every other document pass straight through).
            function currentPage() {
                if (!currentLayout()) return -1;
                try {
                    var p = touchArea.view.page;
                    return (typeof p === "number" && p >= 0) ? p : -1;
                } catch (e) {
                    return -1;
                }
            }

            // Tap point in normalized page coordinates (0..1, top-left
            // origin — the same frame layout.json's tap boxes use),
            // or null when the tap landed off the page. pageBorderRect
            // is the page's on-screen rect, so this stays correct while
            // zoomed or panned.
            function pagePoint(mx, my) {
                var r;
                try {
                    r = touchArea.view.pageBorderRect;
                } catch (e) {
                    return null;
                }
                if (!r || !(r.width > 0) || !(r.height > 0)) return null;
                var nx = (mx - r.x) / r.width;
                var ny = (my - r.y) / r.height;
                if (nx < 0 || nx > 1 || ny < 0 || ny > 1) return null;
                return Qt.point(nx, ny);
            }

            // The underlined run on `page` under the normalized tap
            // point, or null. Boxes are already sized to the glyphs
            // they cover (layout.rs `tap_box`, which also adds the
            // downward slop), so no expansion happens here — a tap on
            // plain text must stay a page turn. Overlaps are expected
            // where a range wraps onto the next row, so the nearest
            // centre wins.
            function hitTap(page, nx, ny) {
                if (!layoutData) return null;
                var candidates = tapsForPage(page);
                var best = null, bestDist = 1e9;
                for (var i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) {
                    var t = candidates[i];
                    if (nx < t.x0 || nx > t.x1 || ny < t.y0 || ny > t.y1) continue;
                    var d = Math.abs(nx - (t.x0 + t.x1) / 2) + Math.abs(ny - (t.y0 + t.y1) / 2);
                    if (d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; best = t; }
                }
                return best;
            }
        }

        MouseArea {
            id: weReadUnderlineTap
            anchors.fill: parent
            z: 900
            propagateComposedEvents: true
            visible: !weReadPopup.visible
            onPressed: (mouse) => {
                var page = weReadIpc.currentPage();
                if (page < 0) { mouse.accepted = false; return; }
                var pt = weReadIpc.pagePoint(mouse.x, mouse.y);
                if (!pt) { mouse.accepted = false; return; }
                var t = weReadIpc.hitTap(page, pt.x, pt.y);
                if (!t) { mouse.accepted = false; return; }
                mouse.accepted = true;
                weReadPopup.quote = "";
                weReadPopup.total = "";
                weReadPopup.errorText = "";
                weReadPopup.reviews = [];
                weReadPopup.mode = "loading";
                weReadPopup.visible = true;
                weReadPopup.lastSeq = weReadIpc.readSeq("reviews.txt");
                weReadCmd.executeCommand("/bin/touch", [
                    "/home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/ask_" + weReadIpc.layoutData.book_id
                        + "_" + t.chapter_uid + "_" + t.range + "_" + Date.now()
                ]);
                weReadReviewPoller.start();
            }
        }

        // Shared look. Greys are Apple's system label/separator ramp,
        // which is what makes this read as a native macOS popover
        // rather than a generic dialog. No colour: this is e-ink.
        //
        // Deliberately NO font.bold anywhere. The shipped NotoSansSC is
        // a variable font, and synthesising bold from it renders thinner
        // than the regular weight on device (rm-agent hit this and had
        // to ship a real static Bold instance). Hierarchy here comes
        // from size and grey level instead, which needs no extra font.
        Item {
            id: weReadStyle
            visible: false
            readonly property color ink: "#1D1D1F"
            readonly property color inkSoft: "#3A3A3C"
            readonly property color inkMuted: "#8E8E93"
            readonly property color hairline: "#E5E5EA"
            readonly property color fill: "#F2F2F7"
            readonly property color surface: "#FFFFFF"
            readonly property color edge: "#C6C6C8"
            readonly property color rim: "#D8D8DC"
            readonly property int radius: 20
            readonly property int pad: 28
        }


        // ── Shelf browser ──────────────────────────────────────────
        // Four-finger tap opens this anywhere in xochitl. It lists the
        // WeRead shelf the daemon published to shelf.json (covers cached
        // beside it as plain files, which is the only way QML can show
        // them — no network from inside xochitl's process), and tapping
        // a book asks the daemon to generate it.
        Item {
            id: weReadShelf
            visible: false
            z: 1600
            width: Math.min(parent.width * 0.86, 1000)
            height: Math.min(parent.height * 0.78, 1500)
            anchors.centerIn: parent

            property int lastSeq: 0
            property var books: []
            property string mode: "loading"
            property string errorText: ""

            function open() {
                errorText = "";
                load();
                mode = books.length > 0 ? "ok" : "loading";
                visible = true;
                // Always ask for a fresh shelf, but show the cached one
                // meanwhile so the browser never opens empty.
                lastSeq = weReadIpc.readSeq("shelf.txt");
                weReadCmd.executeCommand("/bin/touch", ["/home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/shelf"]);
                weReadShelfPoller.start();
            }

            function load() {
                var raw = weReadIpc.readFile("shelf.json");
                if (!raw) return;
                try {
                    var v = JSON.parse(raw);
                    books = v.books || [];
                } catch (e) {
                    books = [];
                }
            }

            function generate(book) {
                visible = false;
                weReadShelfPoller.stop();
                weReadStatus.lastSeq = weReadIpc.readSeq("gen.txt");
                weReadStatus.message = "正在生成《" + book.title + "》…";
                weReadStatus.visible = true;
                weReadCmd.executeCommand("/bin/touch", [
                    "/home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/gen_" + book.book_id + "_" + Date.now()
                ]);
                weReadGenPoller.start();
            }

            Rectangle {
                anchors.fill: parent
                anchors.topMargin: 4
                anchors.bottomMargin: -4
                radius: weReadStyle.radius + 2
                color: weReadStyle.rim
            }

            Rectangle {
                anchors.fill: parent
                radius: weReadStyle.radius
                color: weReadStyle.surface
                border.color: weReadStyle.edge
                border.width: 1
                clip: true

                Column {
                    id: weReadShelfHeader
                    anchors.top: parent.top
                    anchors.left: parent.left
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    anchors.margins: weReadStyle.pad
                    spacing: 8

                    Text {
                        font.family: weReadFont.name
                        font.pixelSize: 30
                        color: weReadStyle.ink
                        text: "微信读书"
                    }
                    Text {
                        font.family: weReadFont.name
                        font.pixelSize: 20
                        color: weReadStyle.inkMuted
                        text: weReadShelf.mode === "ok"
                            ? "选一本生成到设备"
                            : weReadShelf.mode === "error" ? weReadShelf.errorText : "正在读取书架…"
                    }
                }

                Rectangle {
                    id: weReadShelfRule
                    anchors.top: weReadShelfHeader.bottom
                    anchors.topMargin: weReadStyle.pad - 8
                    anchors.left: parent.left
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    height: 1
                    color: weReadStyle.hairline
                }

                Flickable {
                    id: weReadShelfFlick
                    anchors.top: weReadShelfRule.bottom
                    anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                    anchors.left: parent.left
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    contentHeight: weReadShelfList.height
                    clip: true
                    boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds

                    Column {
                        id: weReadShelfList
                        width: weReadShelfFlick.width

                        Repeater {
                            model: weReadShelf.books

                            delegate: Item {
                                width: weReadShelfList.width
                                height: 200

                                MouseArea {
                                    anchors.fill: parent
                                    onClicked: weReadShelf.generate(modelData)
                                }

                                Rectangle {
                                    id: weReadShelfCover
                                    x: weReadStyle.pad
                                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                    width: 116
                                    height: 166
                                    color: weReadStyle.fill
                                    border.color: weReadStyle.hairline
                                    border.width: 1

                                    Image {
                                        anchors.fill: parent
                                        anchors.margins: 1
                                        fillMode: Image.PreserveAspectCrop
                                        asynchronous: true
                                        cache: false
                                        visible: modelData.cover !== ""
                                        source: modelData.cover
                                            ? "file:///home/root/xovi/exthome/weread/" + modelData.cover
                                            : ""
                                    }
                                }

                                Column {
                                    anchors.left: weReadShelfCover.right
                                    anchors.leftMargin: 22
                                    anchors.right: parent.right
                                    anchors.rightMargin: weReadStyle.pad
                                    anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                                    spacing: 10

                                    Text {
                                        width: parent.width
                                        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                                        maximumLineCount: 2
                                        elide: Text.ElideRight
                                        font.family: weReadFont.name
                                        font.pixelSize: 27
                                        color: weReadStyle.ink
                                        text: modelData.title
                                    }
                                    Text {
                                        width: parent.width
                                        elide: Text.ElideRight
                                        font.family: weReadFont.name
                                        font.pixelSize: 21
                                        color: weReadStyle.inkMuted
                                        text: modelData.author
                                    }
                                    Rectangle {
                                        width: weReadShelfBadge.implicitWidth + 22
                                        height: weReadShelfBadge.implicitHeight + 12
                                        radius: height / 2
                                        color: weReadStyle.fill
                                        border.color: weReadStyle.hairline
                                        border.width: 1
                                        visible: modelData.generated

                                        Text {
                                            id: weReadShelfBadge
                                            anchors.centerIn: parent
                                            font.family: weReadFont.name
                                            font.pixelSize: 18
                                            color: weReadStyle.inkMuted
                                            text: "已在设备上 · 点按刷新"
                                        }
                                    }
                                }

                                Rectangle {
                                    anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                                    anchors.left: parent.left
                                    anchors.leftMargin: weReadStyle.pad
                                    anchors.right: parent.right
                                    height: 1
                                    color: weReadStyle.hairline
                                    visible: index < weReadShelf.books.length - 1
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                Text {
                    anchors.top: weReadShelfRule.bottom
                    anchors.left: parent.left
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                    anchors.margins: weReadStyle.pad
                    horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                    verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                    wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                    font.family: weReadFont.name
                    font.pixelSize: 23
                    color: weReadStyle.inkMuted
                    visible: weReadShelf.books.length === 0
                    text: weReadShelf.mode === "error" ? weReadShelf.errorText : "正在读取书架…"
                }

                Rectangle {
                    width: 4
                    radius: 2
                    color: weReadStyle.edge
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    anchors.rightMargin: 8
                    visible: weReadShelfFlick.contentHeight > weReadShelfFlick.height
                    height: Math.max(48, weReadShelfFlick.height * weReadShelfFlick.height
                        / Math.max(1, weReadShelfFlick.contentHeight))
                    y: weReadShelfFlick.y + weReadShelfFlick.contentY
                       * (weReadShelfFlick.height - height)
                       / Math.max(1, weReadShelfFlick.contentHeight - weReadShelfFlick.height)
                }
            }
        }

        MouseArea {
            id: weReadShelfDismiss
            anchors.fill: parent
            z: 1550
            visible: weReadShelf.visible
            onClicked: {
                weReadShelf.visible = false;
                weReadShelfPoller.stop();
            }
        }

        Timer {
            id: weReadShelfPoller
            interval: 400
            repeat: true
            property int elapsedMs: 0
            onTriggered: {
                elapsedMs += interval;
                var lines = weReadIpc.readFile("shelf.txt").split("\n");
                var seq = parseInt(lines[0]);
                if (!isNaN(seq) && seq > weReadShelf.lastSeq) {
                    weReadShelf.lastSeq = seq;
                    var status = lines.length > 1 ? lines[1] : "";
                    if (status === "working") { elapsedMs = 0; return; }
                    if (status === "ok" || status === "done") {
                        weReadShelf.load();
                        weReadShelf.mode = "ok";
                    } else {
                        weReadShelf.errorText = lines.length > 2 ? lines.slice(2).join(" ") : "读取书架失败";
                        weReadShelf.mode = "error";
                    }
                    elapsedMs = 0;
                    stop();
                    return;
                }
                // Covers download on first sync, so allow a while.
                if (elapsedMs > 120000) {
                    weReadShelf.errorText = "读取书架超时";
                    weReadShelf.mode = "error";
                    elapsedMs = 0;
                    stop();
                }
            }
        }


        // Live underline overlay.
        //
        // Proven on device, in this order: QML does paint over
        // xochitl's PDF surface, the layer survives page turns, and pen
        // ink lands *on top* of it rather than being erased by it — the
        // one thing that killed the old fullscreen reader. The catch
        // found in the same test: anything opaque hides ink behind it,
        // so this draws hairlines under the baseline and never fills.
        //
        // Written in the idiom the shelf browser already proves works
        // (Repeater over a plain JS array, Rectangle delegates). The
        // first attempt used a tiled Image, a var-array property and a
        // polling Timer together, and stopped the entire injected block
        // from instantiating with no error logged at all.
        Item {
            id: weReadOverlay
            anchors.fill: parent
            z: 700

            // Same binding idiom as weReadIpc.docId, which works.
            property int curPage: {
                try {
                    return touchArea.view ? touchArea.view.page : -1;
                } catch (e) {
                    return -1;
                }
            }

            property var rules: []

            // Verification offset: drawn 10px below the printed rule so
            // the two can be told apart. Zero once the underlines stop
            // being burned into the PDF.
            readonly property int probeOffset: 10

            onCurPageChanged: rebuild()
            Component.onCompleted: rebuild()

            function rebuild() {
                var page = weReadIpc.currentPage();
                var l = weReadIpc.layoutData;
                if (page < 0 || !l) { rules = []; return; }
                weReadIpc.requestHot(page);
                var r;
                try { r = touchArea.view.pageBorderRect; } catch (e) { rules = []; return; }
                if (!r || !(r.width > 0)) { rules = []; return; }

                var out = [];
                var taps = weReadIpc.tapsForPage(page);
                for (var i = 0; i < taps.length; i++) {
                    var t = taps[i];
                    // The rule sits at baseline + 3pt inside the line
                    // box; a tap box is the line box plus 30% slop
                    // below, so the line height is (y1 - y0) / 1.3.
                    var lineH = (t.y1 - t.y0) / 1.3;
                    out.push({
                        rx: r.x + t.x0 * r.width,
                        ry: r.y + (t.y0 + 0.78 * lineH + 3.0 / 936.0) * r.height + probeOffset,
                        rw: (t.x1 - t.x0) * r.width
                    });
                }
                rules = out;
                weReadIpc.beacon("rules_p" + page + "_n" + out.length);
            }

            Repeater {
                model: weReadOverlay.rules
                delegate: Rectangle {
                    x: modelData.rx
                    y: modelData.ry
                    width: modelData.rw
                    height: 3
                    color: "black"
                }
            }
        }

        Timer {
            id: weReadHotPoller
            interval: 700
            repeat: true
            property int elapsedMs: 0
            onTriggered: {
                elapsedMs += interval;
                var lines = weReadIpc.readFile("hot.txt").split("\n");
                var seq = parseInt(lines[0]);
                if (!isNaN(seq) && seq > weReadIpc.hotSeq) {
                    weReadIpc.hotSeq = seq;
                    var parts = (lines.length > 2 ? lines[2] : "").split(" ");
                    if (parts.length >= 2 && weReadIpc.loadHot(parts[0], parts[1])) {
                        weReadOverlay.rebuild();
                    }
                    elapsedMs = 0;
                    stop();
                    return;
                }
                if (elapsedMs > 30000) { elapsedMs = 0; stop(); }
            }
        }

        Item {
            id: weReadStatus
            visible: false
            z: 1500
            width: Math.min(parent.width * 0.72, 660)
            height: weReadStatusText.implicitHeight + 40
            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
            y: 28
            property int lastSeq: 0
            property string message: ""

            Rectangle {
                anchors.fill: parent
                anchors.topMargin: 3
                anchors.bottomMargin: -3
                radius: weReadStyle.radius - 4
                color: weReadStyle.rim
            }

            Rectangle {
                anchors.fill: parent
                radius: weReadStyle.radius - 6
                color: weReadStyle.surface
                border.color: weReadStyle.edge
                border.width: 1

                Text {
                    id: weReadStatusText
                    anchors.centerIn: parent
                    width: parent.width - 48
                    wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                    horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                    font.family: weReadFont.name
                    font.pixelSize: 23
                    lineHeight: 1.25
                    color: weReadStyle.inkSoft
                    text: weReadStatus.message
                }
            }

            MouseArea {
                anchors.fill: parent
                onClicked: { weReadStatus.visible = false; weReadGenPoller.stop(); }
            }
        }

        Timer {
            id: weReadGenPoller
            interval: 500
            repeat: true
            property int elapsedMs: 0
            onTriggered: {
                elapsedMs += interval;
                var raw = weReadIpc.readFile("gen.txt");
                var lines = raw.split("\n");
                var seq = parseInt(lines[0]);
                if (!isNaN(seq) && seq > weReadStatus.lastSeq) {
                    weReadStatus.lastSeq = seq;
                    var status = lines.length > 1 ? lines[1] : "";
                    weReadStatus.message = lines.length > 2 ? lines.slice(2).join(" ") : "";
                    if (status === "working") { elapsedMs = 0; return; }
                    // A fresh generation may have rewritten the layout
                    // for the document that's open; drop the cache so
                    // the next tap re-reads it.
                    weReadIpc.layoutDocId = "";
                    weReadIpc.layoutData = null;
                    elapsedMs = 0;
                    stop();
                    weReadStatusHide.restart();
                    return;
                }
                // A whole book takes a while; only give up after 30 min.
                if (elapsedMs > 1800000) {
                    weReadStatus.message = "(超时，看看 daemon 日志)";
                    elapsedMs = 0;
                    stop();
                }
            }
        }

        Timer {
            id: weReadStatusHide
            interval: 8000
            onTriggered: weReadStatus.visible = false
        }

        Item {
            id: weReadPopup
            visible: false
            z: 1500
            width: Math.min(parent.width * 0.82, 940)
            height: Math.min(parent.height * 0.64, 1200)
            anchors.centerIn: parent

            property int lastSeq: 0
            property string quote: ""
            property string total: ""
            property string errorText: ""
            // Array of { author, content } — a plain JS array rather
            // than a ListModel so this needs no extra QML import inside
            // xochitl's own module set.
            property var reviews: []
            // "loading" | "ok" | "error"
            property string mode: "loading"

            // Depth without transparency: a translucent drop shadow
            // dithers into visible speckle on e-ink, while a solid grey
            // rim peeking out below the card stays crisp at 1 bit.
            Rectangle {
                anchors.fill: parent
                anchors.topMargin: 4
                anchors.bottomMargin: -4
                radius: weReadStyle.radius + 2
                color: weReadStyle.rim
            }

            Rectangle {
                anchors.fill: parent
                radius: weReadStyle.radius
                color: weReadStyle.surface
                border.color: weReadStyle.edge
                border.width: 1
                clip: true

                Column {
                    id: weReadHeader
                    anchors.top: parent.top
                    anchors.left: parent.left
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    anchors.margins: weReadStyle.pad
                    spacing: 14

                    Row {
                        width: parent.width
                        spacing: 16

                        // Blockquote rule, matched to the quote's height.
                        Rectangle {
                            width: 4
                            height: weReadQuote.height
                            radius: 2
                            color: weReadStyle.inkMuted
                            visible: weReadQuote.visible
                        }

                        Text {
                            id: weReadQuote
                            width: parent.width - 20
                            wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                            maximumLineCount: 3
                            elide: Text.ElideRight
                            font.family: weReadFont.name
                            font.pixelSize: 27
                            lineHeight: 1.3
                            color: weReadStyle.ink
                            visible: text.length > 0
                            text: weReadPopup.quote
                        }
                    }

                    Text {
                        font.family: weReadFont.name
                        font.pixelSize: 20
                        color: weReadStyle.inkMuted
                        visible: weReadPopup.mode === "ok"
                        text: weReadPopup.total + " 条想法"
                    }
                }

                Rectangle {
                    id: weReadHeaderRule
                    anchors.top: weReadHeader.bottom
                    anchors.topMargin: weReadStyle.pad - 8
                    anchors.left: parent.left
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    height: 1
                    color: weReadStyle.hairline
                    visible: weReadPopup.mode === "ok" && weReadPopup.reviews.length > 0
                }

                // Loading / empty / error all land here, centred and
                // quiet — never an alarming black wall of text.
                Text {
                    anchors.top: weReadHeaderRule.bottom
                    anchors.left: parent.left
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                    anchors.margins: weReadStyle.pad
                    horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                    verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                    wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                    font.family: weReadFont.name
                    font.pixelSize: 23
                    color: weReadStyle.inkMuted
                    visible: weReadPopup.mode !== "ok" || weReadPopup.reviews.length === 0
                    text: weReadPopup.mode === "error" ? weReadPopup.errorText
                        : weReadPopup.mode === "loading" ? "正在加载评论…"
                        : "还没有人写想法"
                }

                Flickable {
                    id: weReadFlick
                    anchors.top: weReadHeaderRule.bottom
                    anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                    anchors.left: parent.left
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    contentHeight: weReadList.height
                    clip: true
                    visible: weReadPopup.mode === "ok" && weReadPopup.reviews.length > 0
                    boundsBehavior: Flickable.StopAtBounds

                    Column {
                        id: weReadList
                        width: weReadFlick.width

                        Repeater {
                            model: weReadPopup.reviews

                            delegate: Item {
                                width: weReadList.width
                                height: weReadBody.height + 44

                                Rectangle {
                                    id: weReadAvatar
                                    x: weReadStyle.pad
                                    y: 22
                                    width: 46
                                    height: 46
                                    radius: 23
                                    color: weReadStyle.fill
                                    border.color: weReadStyle.hairline
                                    border.width: 1

                                    Text {
                                        anchors.centerIn: parent
                                        font.family: weReadFont.name
                                        font.pixelSize: 22
                                        color: weReadStyle.inkMuted
                                        text: (modelData.author || "?").substring(0, 1)
                                    }
                                }

                                Column {
                                    id: weReadBody
                                    y: 22
                                    anchors.left: weReadAvatar.right
                                    anchors.leftMargin: 16
                                    anchors.right: parent.right
                                    anchors.rightMargin: weReadStyle.pad
                                    spacing: 7

                                    Text {
                                        font.family: weReadFont.name
                                        font.pixelSize: 21
                                        color: weReadStyle.inkMuted
                                        text: modelData.author
                                    }

                                    Text {
                                        width: parent.width
                                        wrapMode: Text.Wrap
                                        textFormat: Text.PlainText
                                        font.family: weReadFont.name
                                        font.pixelSize: 25
                                        lineHeight: 1.35
                                        color: weReadStyle.inkSoft
                                        text: modelData.content
                                    }
                                }

                                // Inset separator, aligned to the text
                                // column rather than the card edge.
                                Rectangle {
                                    anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                                    anchors.left: parent.left
                                    anchors.leftMargin: weReadStyle.pad + 62
                                    anchors.right: parent.right
                                    height: 1
                                    color: weReadStyle.hairline
                                    visible: index < weReadPopup.reviews.length - 1
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Overlay scroller, macOS style: only there when the
                // content actually overflows.
                Rectangle {
                    width: 4
                    radius: 2
                    color: weReadStyle.edge
                    anchors.right: parent.right
                    anchors.rightMargin: 8
                    visible: weReadFlick.visible && weReadFlick.contentHeight > weReadFlick.height
                    height: Math.max(48, weReadFlick.height * weReadFlick.height / Math.max(1, weReadFlick.contentHeight))
                    y: weReadFlick.y + weReadFlick.contentY
                       * (weReadFlick.height - height)
                       / Math.max(1, weReadFlick.contentHeight - weReadFlick.height)
                }
            }
        }

        MouseArea {
            id: weReadPopupDismiss
            anchors.fill: parent
            z: 1400
            visible: weReadPopup.visible
            onClicked: {
                weReadPopup.visible = false;
                weReadReviewPoller.stop();
            }
        }

        Timer {
            id: weReadReviewPoller
            interval: 300
            repeat: true
            property int elapsedMs: 0
            onTriggered: {
                elapsedMs += interval;
                var raw = weReadIpc.readFile("reviews.txt");
                var lines = raw.split("\n");
                var seq = parseInt(lines[0]);
                if (!isNaN(seq) && seq > weReadPopup.lastSeq) {
                    weReadPopup.lastSeq = seq;
                    var status = lines.length > 1 ? lines[1] : "";
                    if (status === "ok") {
                        weReadPopup.quote = lines.length > 2 ? lines[2] : "";
                        weReadPopup.total = lines.length > 3 ? lines[3] : "0";
                        var list = [];
                        for (var i = 4; i < lines.length; i++) {
                            if (!lines[i]) continue;
                            var tab = lines[i].indexOf("\t");
                            list.push({
                                author: tab >= 0 ? lines[i].substring(0, tab) : "读者",
                                content: tab >= 0 ? lines[i].substring(tab + 1) : lines[i]
                            });
                        }
                        weReadPopup.reviews = list;
                        weReadPopup.mode = "ok";
                    } else {
                        weReadPopup.errorText = lines.length > 2 ? lines.slice(2).join(" ") : "出错了";
                        weReadPopup.mode = "error";
                    }
                    elapsedMs = 0;
                    stop();
                    return;
                }
                if (elapsedMs > 20000) {
                    weReadPopup.errorText = "加载超时，请重试";
                    weReadPopup.mode = "error";
                    elapsedMs = 0;
                    stop();
                }
            }
        }
    }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
